Test Case Description: Verify PO-ACK Recon Projects page loads successfully
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login to the application.
2. Navigate to PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
Expected Result: PO-ACK Recon Projects page should load successfully with project list, search bar, and New Project button displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify project list is displayed
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login to the application.
2. Navigate to PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
Expected Result: List of available projects should be displayed with Project Name, Org Name, and Created Date columns.

Test Case Description: Verify project details are displayed correctly
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
2. Review project records.
Expected Result: Each project row should display the document list.

Test Case Description: Verify vertical scrolling functionality in project list
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
2. Scroll down using the scrollbar.
Expected Result: User should be able to scroll through all available projects without UI issues.

Test Case Description: Verify search box is visible
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
Expected Result: Search Projects textbox should be visible and enabled.

Test Case Description: Verify search functionality with valid project name
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
2. Enter an existing project name in Search Projects field.
Expected Result: Matching project should be displayed in search results.

Test Case Description: Verify search functionality with partial project name
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
2. Enter partial project name in Search Projects field.
Expected Result: All matching projects containing the entered text should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify search functionality with invalid project name
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
2. Enter non- existing project name in Search Projects field.
Expected Result: No matching records message should be displayed or project list should be empty.

Test Case Description: Verify search field clear functionality
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
2. Enter an existing project name in Search Projects field.
3. Clear the search text.
Expected Result: Complete project list should be displayed again.

Test Case Description: Verify New Project button visibility
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
Expected Result: New Project button should be visible and enabled.

Test Case Description: Verify New Project popup opens successfully
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
2. Click New Project button.
Expected Result: New PO-ACK Recon Project popup should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify popup UI elements
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open PO-ACK Recon Projects page.
2. Click New Project button.
Expected Result: Popup should contain Project Name textbox, Create button, Cancel button, and Close (X) icon.

Test Case Description: Verify Project Name textbox is editable
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open New Project popup.
2. Enter text in Project Name field.
Expected Result: User should be able to enter project name successfully.

Test Case Description: Verify Create button functionality with valid project name
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open New Project popup.
2. Enter valid project name.
3. Click Create.
Expected Result: New project should be created successfully and displayed in project list.

Test Case Description: Verify Create button behavior when Project Name is empty
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open New Project popup.
2. Leave Project Name blank.
3. Click Create.
Expected Result: Validation message should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify duplicate project name creation
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open New Project popup.
2. Enter an existing project name.
3. Click Create.
Expected Result: Appropriate validation message should be displayed if duplicate names are not allowed.

Test Case Description: Verify Cancel button functionality
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open New Project popup.
2. Click Cancel.
Expected Result: Popup should close without creating a project.

Test Case Description: Verify Close (X) icon functionality
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open New Project popup.
2. Click X icon.
Expected Result: Popup should close successfully.

Test Case Description: Verify popup closes on pressing Escape key
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open New Project popup.
2. Press Esc key.
Expected Result: Popup should close if Escape key support is implemented.

Test Case Description: Verify newly created project appears in project list
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new project.
2. Return to project list.
Expected Result: Newly created project should be displayed in the project list with correct details.

Test Case Description: Verify no UI overlap or truncation in project list
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open project page.
2. Review UI elements and records.
Expected Result: All project details should be properly aligned without overlapping or truncation.

Test Case Description: Verify Project Name breadcrumb is clickable

2. Click the Project Name breadcrumb.

Test Case Description: Verify breadcrumb navigation from Review page
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open a PO-ACK Recon document Review page.
2. Click the Project Name breadcrumb.
3. Navigate back and click PO-ACK Recon.
Expected Result: Each breadcrumb should navigate to its respective page without errors.

Test Case Description: Verify that a single PO is reflected on the Review page

2. Navigate to the Review page.
3. Click on View PDFs dropdown.
4. Observe the UI.
Expected Result: The submitted PO should be displayed on the Review page with the extracted values.

2. Navigate to the Review page.
3. Try to edit the extracted values.
Expected Result: The extracted values should be displayed as read-only and the user should not be able to edit them.

Test Case Description: Verify extracted view displays "ACK yet to add" when no ACK is received
Steps to Reproduce:

Test Case Description: Verify user can access the ACK dropdown
Steps to Reproduce:

Expected Result: The ACK dropdown should be accessible and the available ACK files should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify user can access the PDF dropdown
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Review page.
2. Click View PDFs.
Expected Result: The PDF dropdown/view should open and allow the user to view the available documents and the dropdown should change to Collapse PDF'S

Test Case Description: Verify the Collapse PDF's button
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Review page.
2. Click Collapse PDF's button.
Expected Result: The PDF view should be hide and the button should change to View PDFs.

Test Case Description: Verify Complete button is enabled for the first extraction
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open a newly extracted PO/ACK on the Review page.
2. Observe the Complete button.
Expected Result: The Complete button should be enabled for the first extraction.

Test Case Description: Verify Complete button becomes disabled after clicking Complete
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Review page.
2. Click Complete.
3. Check the Complete button.
Expected Result: The Complete button should become disabled after clicking Complete and remain disabled until new changes are saved.

Test Case Description: Verify edit icon is displayed on hovering over header fields
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Review page.
2. Hover over an editable header/address field.
Expected Result: An edit icon should be displayed when the user hovers over the field.

Test Case Description: Verify user can edit existing header field values
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Hover over an editable header field.
2. Click the edit icon.
3. Update the value.
4. Save the changes.
Expected Result: The user should be able to edit and save the existing field value.

Test Case Description: Verify discrepancy fields are highlighted in yellow
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Review page.
2. Compare PO and ACK extracted values.
Expected Result: Fields having discrepancies between PO and ACK should be highlighted in yellow.

Test Case Description: Verify Select All selects all discrepancy fields
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Review page.
2. Click Select All.
Expected Result: All discrepancy fields should be selected/tagged.

Test Case Description: Verify selected discrepancy count is displayed
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Select multiple discrepancy fields.
2. Check the Preview selected option/count.
Expected Result: The selected discrepancy count should be displayed correctly.

Test Case Description: Verify Preview Selected popup displays selected fields
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Select discrepancy fields.
2. Click Preview selected.
Expected Result: A popup should open displaying all the selected discrepancy fields.

Test Case Description: Verify selected fields can be copied
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Select discrepancy fields.
2. Open Preview selected.
3. Click Copy.
4. Paste the copied content somewhere.
Expected Result: The selected field details should be copied successfully and can be pasted into another location.

Test Case Description: Verify flag icon is displayed on hovering over discrepancy fields
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Hover over a discrepancy field.
2. Check the field actions.
Expected Result: A flag icon should be displayed when hovering over the discrepancy field.

Test Case Description: Verify user can select a discrepancy flag
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Hover over a discrepancy field.
2. Click the flag icon.
Expected Result: The user should be able to select/tag the discrepancy using the flag icon.

Test Case Description: Verify flag color changes based on discrepancy level
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Identify Low, Medium, and Critical discrepancies.
2. Check the flag color for each discrepancy.
Expected Result: Low should display Brown, Medium should display Orange, and Critical should display Red.

Test Case Description: Verify Edit All allows editing of line-item fields
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Review page.
2. Click Edit All in the Line Items section.
3. Try to edit line-item fields.
Expected Result: All applicable line-item fields should become editable.

Test Case Description: Verify discrepancy highlighting is created after editing line items
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Click Edit All.
2. Modify a line-item value.
3. Click Save and Continue.
4. Check the modified field.
Expected Result: Based on the updated value, the appropriate discrepancy highlighting should be displayed after saving.

Test Case Description: Verify selected ACK file displays its corresponding extracted data
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open a PO with multiple ACK files.
2. Open the ACK dropdown.
3. Select an ACK file.
Expected Result: The extracted data corresponding to the selected ACK file should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify switching between ACK files retains selected flags
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Select flags for an ACK file.
2. Switch to another ACK file from the dropdown.
3. Switch back to the previous ACK file.
4. Check the selected flags.
Expected Result: The previously selected flags should remain unchanged when returning to the ACK file.

Test Case Description: Verify Extracted data changes based on selected ACK file
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open a PO with multiple ACK files.
2. Select an ACK file from the dropdown.
3. Select another ACK file and check the PDF.
Expected Result: The Extracted data displayed should correspond to the selected ACK file.

Test Case Description: Verify edited values are retained after Save and Continue
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Click Edit All.
2. Modify one or more line-item values.
3. Click Save and Continue.
4. Recheck the edited fields.
Expected Result: The updated values should be saved and displayed correctly after saving.
